articles.title: Ether’s biggest corporate holders back new Ethereum research hub
articles.snippet: Ethlabs was formed with support from SharpLink, Bitmine and Consensys CEO Joe Lubin as the network's development is expanding beyond the Ethereum Foundation.

articles.title: TradFi fund manager Baillie Gifford introduces Solana, Ethereum tokenized fund with BNY
articles.snippet: Baillie Gifford Enhanced Yield Fund (BAGEY) is denominated in dollars, and gives eligible investors access to an actively managed, short-duration portfolio of public corporate bonds.

articles.title: Ethereum's biggest 'sandwich' bot drained of $7.5 million in ironic exploit
articles.snippet: Blockaid said an attacker tricked Jaredfromsubway.eth into approving fake trading routes, then used those approvals to drain WETH, USDC and USDT.

articles.title: Andrew Cuomo to lead joint TradFi-crypto venture between OKX and Intercontinental Exchange
articles.snippet: The venture is subject to regulatory approvals but will be co-chaired by ICE and former New York Governor Andrew Cuomo, who began working with OKX in 2023.

articles.title: Bank of England eases stablecoin rules, introduces 40B pound issuance cap
articles.snippet: The Bank of England published draft rules for systemic stablecoins, easing reserve requirements and replacing holding limits with a temporary 40-billion British pound issuance cap.
